key: Avi-ADAM/1.0::security/handler-state-write::src/routes/+layout.js:34::a server-executed handler writes imported module state "locale" — module state is shared across all requests on the server; if this holds per-request or per-user data, one user's data can leak to another. basis: read src/routes/+layout.js:34: universal root load calls locale.set(lang) on the sveltekit-i18n module singleton ($lib/translations/index.js); `export const ssr = !import.meta.env.VITE_TAURI` is non-literal, so the web build SSRs and this per-user language write is shared by concurrent requests (the app's own +layout.server.js:7-12 comment documents this exact cross-request locale leak)

key: Avi-ADAM/1.0::security/handler-state-write::src/routes/api/bot/+server.js:191::a server-executed handler writes imported module state "locale" — module state is shared across all requests on the server; if this holds per-request or per-user data, one user's data can leak to another. basis: read src/routes/api/bot/+server.js:191: POST handler does `await locale.set(user.lang)` on the process-wide sveltekit-i18n store, then awaits loadTranslations/Gemini and reads t.get(...) for its reply — a concurrent request with another lang overwrites it mid-request, so users get replies in another user's language (per-request state in shared module state)
